headline_marked: Topu Barman predicts [[Argentina to win 2-0]] against Algeria
headline: Topu Barman predicts Argentina to win 2-0 against Algeria
summary: Bangladesh veteran defender and Bashundhara Kings captain expects a winning start for the defending champions despite fitness concerns for key players.
details: Bangladesh's veteran defender and Bashundhara Kings captain Topu Barman predicts a 2-0 victory for Argentina in their opening FIFA World Cup match against Algeria.
Despite concerns over the fitness of key players like Gonzalo Montiel and Nahuel Molina, Topu believes the form of Mac Allister, Enzo Fernandez, and Lautaro Martinez will secure the win.
He noted that while Algeria possesses experienced players competing in top European leagues, Argentina's quality remains superior.
Topu also highlighted the deep-rooted love for football in Bangladesh, citing the viral 2022 World Cup video from TSC as evidence of the nation's passion.
He expressed pride in Bangladesh being recognized as a football-loving nation, especially after the national flag was seen during the opening ceremony.
Reflecting on the tournament so far, he observed that the competition has become more tighter and more tactical, with six Asian nations earning points in their opening games.
caption:
Can Argentina avoid a repeat of their previous opening defeat? Topu Barman predicts a 2-0 win.

Bangladesh's veteran defender and Bashundhara Kings captain Topu Barman predicts a 2-0 victory for Argentina in their opening FIFA World Cup match against Algeria.

Despite concerns over the fitness of key players like Gonzalo Montiel and Nahuel Molina, Topu believes the form of Mac Allister, Enzo Fernandez, and Lautaro Martinez will secure the win.

He noted that while Algeria possesses experienced players competing in top European leagues, Argentina's quality remains superior.

Topu also highlighted the deep-rooted love for football in Bangladesh, citing the viral 2022 World Cup video from TSC as evidence of the nation's passion.

He expressed pride in Bangladesh being recognized as a football-loving nation, especially after the national flag was seen during the opening ceremony.

Reflecting on the tournament so far, he observed that the competition has become more tighter and more tactical, with six Asian nations earning points in their opening games.

headline_marked: Student [[killed and burnt alive]] in Rajbari over 68k BDT loan
headline: Student killed and burnt alive in Rajbari over 68k BDT loan
summary: Asadul Islam, 22, was tortured and strangled to death by hired killers after failing to repay a loan from an acquaintance. Three suspects have been arrested.
details: Police recovered the burnt body of 22-year-old Asadul Islam from a jute field in Madapur village, Kalukhali Upazila, Rajbari, on Monday morning. His hands and feet were tied up when found.
The victim was a student of Baliyakandi Mir Mosharraf Hossain Degree College. According to police, the murder was motivated by a loan dispute involving 68,000 BDT.
Investigations reveal that Asadul had borrowed the money from an acquaintance, Mizan Sheikh, a few months ago to support his family. After failing to repay the loan within 15 days, a dispute arose.
Mizan allegedly hired professional killers to recover the money. On Sunday night, the killers lured Asadul to a secluded area, where they tortured him and strangled him to death.
To destroy evidence of the torture, the killers poured petrol from a motorcycle and set his body on fire. Police have arrested three suspects, including Mizan Sheikh and two others.
Police seized a motorcycle, iron rods, and a blood-stained helmet as evidence. The suspects provided confessional statements in court on Tuesday afternoon.
The victim's father, Shahjahan Mondal, has filed a murder case against seven to eight unidentified suspects. Police are currently working to capture the remaining fugitives.
